import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_P.restype = ctypes.c_double
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_uniform_cdf_and_ccdf(x, a, b):
    """Compute the CDF and CCDF for a uniform distribution."""
    cdf = gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_P(x, a, b)
    ccdf = gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Q(x, a, b)
    return cdf, ccdf

def assert_test():
    """Run assertion-based test cases."""
    # Test case 1: x < a
    cdf, ccdf = compute_uniform_cdf_and_ccdf(0.0, 1.0, 2.0)
    assert cdf == 0.0, f"Expected CDF=0.0, got {cdf}"
    assert ccdf == 1.0, f"Expected CCDF=1.0, got {ccdf}"

    # Test case 2: x > b
    cdf, ccdf = compute_uniform_cdf_and_ccdf(3.0, 1.0, 2.0)
    assert cdf == 1.0, f"Expected CDF=1.0, got {cdf}"
    assert ccdf == 0.0, f"Expected CCDF=0.0, got {ccdf}"

    # Test case 3: a <= x <= b
    cdf, ccdf = compute_uniform_cdf_and_ccdf(1.5, 1.0, 2.0)
    assert abs(cdf - 0.5) < 1e-9, f"Expected CDF=0.5, got {cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 0.5) < 1e-9, f"Expected CCDF=0.5, got {ccdf}"

    # Test case 4: Edge case x == a
    cdf, ccdf = compute_uniform_cdf_and_ccdf(1.0, 1.0, 2.0)
    assert abs(cdf - 0.0) < 1e-9, f"Expected CDF=0.0, got {cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Expected CCDF=1.0, got {ccdf}"

    # Test case 5: Edge case x == b
    cdf, ccdf = compute_uniform_cdf_and_ccdf(2.0, 1.0, 2.0)
    assert abs(cdf - 1.0) < 1e-9, f"Expected CDF=1.0, got {cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 0.0) < 1e-9, f"Expected CCDF=0.0, got {ccdf}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
